messages.author: f08fdda5ff5291d4
messages.subject: About prior distribution
parts:
Dear INLA friends:

 I have a question about an argument "names(inla.models()$prior)"

If I use this argument, it will give me 43 different prior including gamma, flat. But as I know, we can only assign gaussian prior to parameters, is that correct? why there are so many priors? 

Thanks

Longwen

messages.author: f08fdda5ff5291d4
messages.subject: Re: About prior distribution
parts: I think these priors are set for precisions, right?
